store: Cooper's Row, Sol 6.1 / extra high: thirteen vessels, two tiers, narrow sealed sight strips; prototype

frame.atlas_sources: rows 0-31 hewn timber, 32-63 x0-63 end grain, 64-79 iron: assets/bunker_r4; 32-63 x64-95 dark oiled timber, x96-127 wear swatch: assets/metalpallet_r3; 80-111: clay, dark clay, birch bark, root lashing (r5); 112-127 liquid tiles (5); 128-159: honey-jar clay (r6); 160-175: tiles of the 4 newer liquids (r8)

space: Unity prefab space, origin = skid footprint centre on the ground. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ export (forward NEGATIVE_Z, up Y) writes (bx, bz, -by); Unity's importer negates x, same mapping.
unit_semantics: SETTLED: every copy has an explicit final pose from a rigid-body simulation (convex-hull items, friction 0.75, restitution 0, damping 0.25/0.45), dropped one copy at a time onto the frozen earlier ones; each vessel's copy sequence is cut into its units in drop order. Each copy: the item's bounds centre at unit.position + copy.offset (= copy.world_position), rotated by copy.quat_xyzw (or copy.euler, Unity ZXY), longest side fit_longest_m. unit.position: x = centre of the unit's copies, y = one height for all units, z = the vessel's axis (-by; two rows), so ByGroup tells the vessels apart by the key compartment. unit.box: x = the copies' width, y = from the lowest rotated-bounds corner of any copy in the store to the highest (the never-below-the-floor lift leaves every settled copy alone), z = the chord a divider board may take inside the round vessel (70% of its inner diameter).
fill_order: units are listed in fill order (interleaved over the vessels); within a vessel its units fill bottom up. Show the first n copies of a unit for a partial stack. Later copies rest on earlier ones, earlier ones never move. One item kind per vessel (compartment = vessel 0-12: 0-5 the front row on the deck, 6-12 the back row on the step, each left to right as seen from the front).
liquids_doc: one entry per (vessel, liquid item): obj = a closed prism of height 1 (y 0..1) in this folder, drawn with the frame's material as T(floor) * S(1, (top_y - floor.y) * fill, 1); floor = bottom centre of the liquid (prefab space), top_y = its surface when full. An item with an entry for its vessel is drawn as liquid there, any other item as the units' lumps.
labels_doc: One actual assigned-kind model only for an occupied compartment. Select poses_by_item[prefab], then existing position/rot_quat_xyzw/fit_longest_m bottom-of-rotated-bounds placement. Every accepted model seats on actual board triangles and against actual lip triangles. No support-plane field or extra stock capacity.
lumps_doc: every vessel's units carry Resin lumps (fit_longest_m 0.25 in the front row, 0.20 in the back row, physics-settled as before): the solid fallback for Resin or any item without a liquid entry for that vessel; each unit's item is its vessel's home. Exception: the Blob Vial vessel (compartment 11) carries real Blob Vials (fit_longest_m 0.22, copy item BlobVial, settled the same way) because a vial at a lump's pose clips the wall; checks.lump_substitution_clip_escape_per_vessel counts [frame clipping, wall escapes] per vessel when the mod draws a Blob Vial at the Resin lump poses (and Resin at the vial vessel's poses).

physics_provenance.substitution_method: Complete source-settled same-kind piles uniformly scaled as whole piles about floor centre, preserving contact and drop order; newly settled Eitr pile treated identically.

checks.note: Original121sourcecopies retained and rechecked. Actual recovered Eitr Sphere newly Bullet-settled once (10copies), cached by input hash and revalidated; all known solid substitutions, label/frame and liquid/frame checks rerun.

prototype.author: Sol 6.1 / extra high
prototype.status: isolated prototype; not released or installed
changes: narrow sealed rough-glass sight strips replace wide leaking cutouts; retain open tops and actual-item samples
narrow retaining bars and remove redundant wall rings
prototype.visibility_limit: Fullness is visible through the narrow sight strip, samples identify stock; inspect empty/half/full at standing height before acceptance.
prototype.runtime_contract: Existing r8 units/liquids/labels plus per-item ordinary pose/copy selectors and transparent_parts auxiliary mesh requiring a separate alpha-capable material; thirteen homes, 64 slots. Preserve released prefab identifiers and inventory; test existing stacked placements.
prototype.render_exception: Actual recovered Eitr sphere and settled pile; EEVEE preview approximates recovered native green emission/glossiness, without added point lights.
prototype.sample_placement: Six front-row samples on the10degree retained skid board, seven rear-row samples on the25degree retained shelf behind the first row, immediately in front of the back row. Every actual kind touches board and15mm lip; empty compartments show no sample.

transparent_parts.runtime_note: Requires separate alpha-capable material; the opaque chest atlas material cannot render these strips honestly.
